authority: User instruction, 2026-11-04. Both goals are equally important. The lead owns delivery, evidence, coherence and publication.
completionRule: Both goals must satisfy their evidence-based criteria. Passing one cannot compensate for failure of the other. Usage ceilings are session controls, not success criteria. Do not weaken criteria without an explicit user decision.

goals.name: Procedural Great Wave ocean
goals.objective: Create a visually recognizable Great Wave ocean in the canonical Hokusai woodblock language, using LingDong-style mathematical construction and continuous generation.
goals.finalOutput: A standalone desktop browser experience with an endlessly explorable generated ocean, pale background clouds, defined connected foam and flowing indigo water.

criteria.name: Source likeness
criteria.requirement: The unlabeled whole composition immediately evokes the canonical Great Wave through silhouette, foam anatomy, hollows, contour flow, palette and hierarchy. No texture or title may conceal weak geometry.
criteria.evidence: Native desktop comparisons with the unchanged canonical scan, independent informed visual review, and separate final user artistic acceptance.

criteria.name: Procedural construction and variety
criteria.requirement: Composition, water profiles, crest topology, foam and contours are constructed from geometry. New scenery has materially different anatomy; finished wave sprites, one rescaled template and random decoration do not satisfy this goal.
criteria.evidence: Source review, seeded reproducibility, new and held-out constructions, normalized geometry comparisons and visual repetition review. Report tested uniqueness scope honestly.

criteria.name: Coherent continuous ocean
criteria.requirement: A planner creates wave groups, depth, quiet intervals and clouds. Adjacent regions connect, old locations reproduce after eviction, and working memory remains bounded.
criteria.evidence: Consecutive travel views, seam and occlusion review, eviction/regeneration checks and a documented cache bound. No untested claim of infinite perceptual uniqueness.

criteria.name: Usable, defined desktop experience
criteria.requirement: Slow horizontal travel, pause/manual controls, reduced motion, hidden-tab handling and desktop resizing work. Water and foam remain opaque and connected, without fading joins; rendering remains responsive.
criteria.evidence: Rendered desktop checks at declared viewports/DPR, interaction and sustained-travel checks, runtime errors, frame timing and memory observations on documented hardware.

goals.name: Efficient evaluated agentic development
goals.objective: Develop a small agentic system that reaches the artwork goal through critical thinking, external learning and fast, high-quality experiments with few resources.
goals.finalOutput: A reusable evidence-driven workflow with independent strategy challenge, technical and visual evaluation, bounded lessons, and explicit continuation and resource controls.

criteria.name: Sound independent decisions
criteria.requirement: Challenge assumptions before building. Preserve supported paths, distinguish implementation defects from disproven premises, pivot or reject failed constructions, and defer unsupported judgments.
criteria.evidence: Causal predictions, supporting/contrary evidence, bounded discriminating tests, independent decisions and prospective outcomes including critic mistakes. A valid JSON record alone is insufficient.

criteria.name: Efficiency without quality loss
criteria.requirement: Demonstrate equal or better independently reviewed quality with lower active time and estimated token cost per comparable retained improvement than a declared baseline. Do not trade quality for speed or count activity as progress.
criteria.evidence: Matched baseline/changed-workflow comparisons with consistent quality criteria; report scope, uncertainty, setup/review overhead and estimate overruns. Separate host-sleep gaps from active work; do not invent exact compute.

criteria.name: Useful research and durable learning
criteria.requirement: Learn from relevant primary research and original implementations, transfer tested mechanisms, create new hypotheses and retain evidence-linked lessons. Discard failed active paths and avoid speculative research or an expanding agent fleet without benefit.
criteria.evidence: Short source/mechanism/limit notes, experimental outcomes, stable failure IDs, changed-premise retry conditions and a bounded startup memory.

criteria.name: Ownership, continuity and truthful documentation
criteria.requirement: Every phase stays tied to the two goals, a budget and an observable outcome. Check actual continuation and activity state, respect the user resource ceiling, and update the GitHub README diagram with every architecture change.
criteria.evidence: Fresh startup retains both goals; strategy/result/process records and resource checkpoints exist; deliberate goal or architecture drift fails checks. State local sleep/runtime limits honestly. The lead owns the complete system.

methodInspiration.mechanism: Composition -> generated object geometry -> surface contours -> attached detail -> vector rendering; seeded construction extends scenery as the viewer travels. Adapt the method to Hokusai; do not substitute mountain motifs or finished wave images.

provisionalEvaluationPlan.status: Starting test plans, not automatic artistic acceptance gates; adjust test scope from observed failures without weakening goal requirements.
provisionalEvaluationPlan.art: Compare whole views at 1280 × 720 and 1920 × 1080, then held-out seeds and consecutive regions; expand to DPR 2 and sustained travel as world integration becomes plausible.
provisionalEvaluationPlan.system: Use outcome-hidden calibration when feasible, then prospective decisions and matched baseline experiments. Choose sample sizes and timing targets from pilot variability; report when evidence is insufficient.

nonGoals: Training model weights is not an implied claim of learning.
Boats and Fuji remain undecided; they do not block wave, sky, water and cloud work.
No purchases, quota resets, paid fallback, or unsolicited always-on services.
